case.summary: On 2016-12-01, a $99.92 online transaction on card C07987-K2 was flagged by the real-time model. The transaction originated from a new device profile that was also linked to two other customers' cards. The bank contacted the customer, who confirmed they did not authorize the transaction. The verdict is fraud, and the bank will block the card, monitor connected cards, and file a suspicious activity report.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details a confirmed card-not-present fraud incident involving customer C07987 and card C07987-K2. On 2016-12-01 at 17:28:53, an online transaction of $99.92 was attempted. The transaction was initiated from a device profile (Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720) that was marked as new for this account. Investigation revealed that this same device profile was used on two other cards belonging to two different customers between 2016-11-29 and 2016-12-01. While the amount of $99.92 was consistent with the customer's recurring charges, the use of an unrecognized, shared device raised suspicion. The bank contacted the customer via step-up authentication. The customer stated they still had their card but did not authorize the flagged transaction. Due to the customer's denial and the device's association with multiple accounts, the activity is deemed fraudulent. The total exposure for this incident is $99.92.

stop_reason: The investigation was concluded because the customer confirmed the transaction was unauthorized, providing sufficient evidence to block the card and close the case.
